# Value types

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/events/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Enumerations, identifiers and string formats used by the [Palisade canonical event](index.md).

## AdminChannel

The channel an administrative action came through.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `console` | The console. |
| `api` | The REST API. |
| `cli` | The command-line tool. |
| `scim` | Directory provisioning. |
| `webhook_callback` | A webhook callback. |
| `email_link` | An e-mail link. |
| `chat` | A team-chat action. |
| `itsm` | An ITSM integration. |
| `job` | A scheduled job. |
| `agent` | An agent's own report. |

## ApprovalChannel

The channel an approval was requested or decided through.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `console` | The console. |
| `email` | An e-mail link. |
| `chat` | A team-chat message. |
| `itsm` | An ITSM ticket. |
| `mobile` | A mobile notification. |
| `offline_code` | An offline code read out to the user (#120, #159). |

## ApprovalDecision

Where an approval request stands.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `pending` | Not decided yet. |
| `approved` | Approved. |
| `denied` | Refused. |
| `expired` | Not decided in time. |
| `cancelled` | Withdrawn by the requester. |

## ApprovalKind

What an approval request asks for.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `execute` | Running an application. |
| `install` | Installing software. |
| `elevate` | Elevated rights. |
| `device` | Using a device. |
| `network` | Network or web access. |
| `exception` | A policy exception. |
| `override` | A temporary override of the policy (#120). |

## ApprovalScope

What an approval would cover.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `once` | This one action. |
| `user_on_device` | This user on this device. |
| `device` | This device, for every user. |
| `user` | This user, on every device. |
| `device_group` | A group of devices. |
| `tenant` | The whole tenant. |

## ChangeOp

One kind of change in a JSON Patch-like diff.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `add` | A member was added: `new` only. |
| `remove` | A member was removed: `old` only. |
| `replace` | A member's value changed: `old` and `new`. |

## DnsName

A lowercase DNS name without a trailing dot.

Type: string; 1 to 253 characters; matches `^[a-z0-9_]([a-z0-9_-]{0,61}[a-z0-9_])?(\.[a-z0-9_]([a-z0-9_-]{0,61}[a-z0-9_])?)*$`.

## ElevationMethod

How elevation was obtained.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `jit` | A just-in-time grant, requested and approved (#158). |
| `on_demand` | The user asked for it on one application (#155). |
| `auto` | A rule elevated the application without asking. |
| `challenge_response` | An offline challenge/response code (#159). |
| `uac_replacement` | Palisade's replacement for the OS consent prompt (#155). |

## EncryptionState

Whether a storage device's contents are encrypted.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `encrypted` | Fully encrypted and protected. |
| `unencrypted` | Not encrypted. |
| `suspended` | Encrypted, with protection suspended. |
| `in_progress` | Encryption or decryption is in progress. |

## EventMode

The enforcement mode in effect when the event happened.

This is the policy [`Mode`] as seen by an event, plus two states the
agent can be in. [`EventMode::from_policy_mode`] converts.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `enforce` | Decisions take effect. |
| `monitor` | Decisions are evaluated and would-block decisions reported. |
| `audit` | Like `monitor`, with a full event for every decision. |
| `learning` | Audit, collecting would-block objects as learning candidates. |
| `maintenance` | An unlocked maintenance window (#222). |
| `simulate` | A simulation of a policy that is not deployed. |

| `modified` | The file's content changed. |

| Value | Meaning |

| `local` | A group on one device, or a domain-local group. |

## Guid

A GUID in canonical lowercase form, without braces.

Type: string; matches `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`.

## HealthStatus

The agent's overall health.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `healthy` | Everything works. |
| `degraded` | Working, with a problem that needs attention. |
| `unhealthy` | Not protecting the device. |

## HostId

The ID of an enrolled device, assigned by the server at enrolment.

Type: [`Uuid7`](types.md#uuid7).

## IntegrityLevel

A process integrity level.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `untrusted` | Untrusted. |
| `low` | Low. |
| `medium` | Medium. |
| `medium_plus` | Medium plus. |
| `high` | High. |
| `system` | System. |
| `protected` | Protected process. |

## IpAddress

An IPv4 or IPv6 address in canonical form.

Type: any.

## JsonPointer

A non-empty JSON Pointer (RFC 6901).

Type: string; at most 1024 characters; matches `^(/([^~/]\|~[01])*)+$`.

## JsonValue

A JSON value without null or non-integer numbers. Nesting (at most 16) and size (at most 1024 values) are checked by the reader.

Type: boolean or integer or string or array of [`JsonValue`](types.md#jsonvalue) or map of [`JsonValue`](types.md#jsonvalue).

## Labels

Free-form labels from policy tags.

Type: map of string; at most 64 entries; keys: matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,63}$`.

## LanguageMode

The PowerShell language mode a script ran in.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `full_language` | Full language. |
| `constrained_language` | Constrained language. |
| `restricted_language` | Restricted language. |
| `no_language` | No language. |

## LogonType

How a logon session was created. The names follow the OS logon types
2 to 13.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `interactive` | 2: at the console. |
| `network` | 3: from the network. |
| `batch` | 4: a batch job. |
| `service` | 5: a service. |
| `unlock` | 7: a workstation unlock. |
| `network_cleartext` | 8: from the network with a cleartext password. |
| `new_credentials` | 9: new credentials for outbound connections. |
| `remote_interactive` | 10: remote desktop. |
| `cached_interactive` | 11: with cached credentials. |
| `cached_remote_interactive` | 12: remote desktop with cached credentials. |
| `cached_unlock` | 13: an unlock with cached credentials. |

## ObjectType

The class of object being evaluated. Scripts are `script.<kind>`.

Values: `executable`, `library`, `driver`, `script.powershell`, `script.batch`, `script.cmd`, `script.vbscript`, `script.jscript`, `script.wsf`, `script.wsc`, `script.python`, `script.java`, `script.reg`, `script.other`, `installer`, `compiled_html`, `html_application`, `control_panel_applet`, `packaged_app`, `command`, `com_object`.

## Outcome

What happened.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `allowed` | The action was allowed. |
| `blocked` | The action was blocked. |
| `audited` | The action was allowed, but would have been blocked if enforced. |
| `elevated` | The action ran with elevated rights. |
| `cancelled` | The user or the system cancelled the action. |
| `failed` | The action failed. |
| `info` | Information only: no allow or block decision. |

## PolicyId

The stable ID of a policy.

Type: [`Uuid7`](types.md#uuid7).

Who acted: a person, a client or a component.

| Value | Meaning |

## ProbeStatus

The result of a compliance probe.

| Value | Meaning |

| `pass` | The device meets the requirement. |
| `fail` | The device does not meet the requirement. |

## RegistryDataRule

`truncated` data has a `preview`.

Type: any.

## RegistryKey

A registry key path: the full root key name, then components of 1 to 255 characters separated by `\`.

Type: string; at most 32767 characters; matches `^HKEY_(LOCAL_MACHINE\|USERS\|CURRENT_USER\|CLASSES_ROOT\|CURRENT_CONFIG)(\\[^\\]{1,255})*$`.

## RegistryOperation

What was done to a registry key or value.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `create_key` | A key was created. |
| `delete_key` | A key was deleted. |
| `set_value` | A value was written. |
| `delete_value` | A value was deleted. |
| `read_key` | A key's values or subkeys were read. |
| `read_value` | A value was read. |

## RegistryValueType

The type of registry value data. The names follow the OS value types.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `none` | No type. |
| `string` | A string. |
| `expand_string` | A string with unexpanded environment variables. |
| `binary` | Binary data. |
| `dword` | A 32-bit number. |
| `dword_big_endian` | A 32-bit number, big-endian. |
| `link` | A symbolic link. |
| `multi_string` | A list of strings. |
| `resource_list` | A hardware resource list. |
| `full_resource_descriptor` | A hardware resource descriptor. |
| `resource_requirements_list` | A hardware resource requirements list. |
| `qword` | A 64-bit number. |

## ResolutionMethod

How a remote host name was learned.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `dns` | A DNS query the agent observed. |
| `dns_cache` | The OS resolver cache. |
| `hosts_file` | The local hosts file. |
| `local_name` | NetBIOS, LLMNR or multicast DNS. |
| `tls_sni` | The TLS server name indication. |
| `http_host` | The HTTP `Host` header. |
| `reverse_dns` | A reverse lookup of the remote address. |
| `requested` | The name the application asked for, before resolution. |

## RuleId

The stable ID of a rule. It is never reused, even after the rule is deleted.

Type: [`Uuid7`](types.md#uuid7).

## SchemaVersion

A semantic version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, without pre-release or build suffixes.

Type: string; matches `^(0\|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0\|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0\|[1-9][0-9]*)$`.

## ScriptKind

The kind of script, for [`ObjectType::Script`].

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `powershell` | `.ps1`, `.psm1`, `.psd1`. |
| `batch` | `.bat`. |
| `cmd` | `.cmd`. |
| `vbscript` | `.vbs`, `.vbe`. |
| `jscript` | `.js`, `.jse` run by the OS script host. |
| `wsf` | `.wsf`. |
| `wsc` | `.wsc`, `.sct` scriptlets. |
| `python` | `.py`, `.pyw`, `.pyc`, `.pyo`. |
| `java` | `.jar`, `.class`. |
| `reg` | `.reg` registry scripts. |
| `other` | Any other interpreted script. |

## Severity

Event severity, 0 (lowest) to 10 (highest).

Type: integer; 0 to 10.

## Sid

A Windows security identifier in its canonical text form.

Type: string; matches `^S-1-(0\|[1-9][0-9]{0,9}\|0x[0-9A-F]{12})(-(0\|[1-9][0-9]{0,9})){0,15}$`.

## SourceKind

A kind of log that events can be translated from.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `os_code_integrity` | The OS code integrity log. |
| `os_legacy_rule_collection` | The OS legacy rule-collection logs. |
| `os_security` | The OS Security log. |
| `os_powershell` | The PowerShell logs. |
| `third_party` | Events imported from another product, in a generic format named by `source.format`. Since 1.1. |

## TenantId

The ID of a tenant.

Type: [`Uuid7`](types.md#uuid7).

## Timestamp

An RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with exactly six fractional digits and `Z`.

Type: string; format `date-time`; matches `^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]\|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]\|[12][0-9]\|3[01])T([01][0-9]\|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]\.[0-9]{6}Z$`.

## Token

A lowercase machine-readable word.

Type: string; matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$`.

## TokenElevationType

The elevation type of a process token.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `default` | No split token (UAC off, or a built-in or service account). |
| `full` | The elevated half of a split token. |
| `limited` | The filtered half of a split token. |

## Uuid7

A UUID version 7 in canonical lowercase form.

Type: string; matches `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`.

## Zone

The security zone a file was downloaded from (its mark of the web).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `local_machine` | Zone 0: the local machine. |
| `intranet` | Zone 1: the local intranet. |
| `trusted` | Zone 2: trusted sites. |
| `internet` | Zone 3: the internet. |
| `restricted` | Zone 4: restricted sites. |
